messages:
andrew: kicking off prod deploy for service redwood-inference-runtime. change window 22:00-23:00 PST. canary 5% -> target 25%. pinned to v2.3.1. runbooks: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/deploy-backout and https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/unpin-procedure. cc @ops-jen @maria

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (rl-2026-04-01-12). 5% -> 10% over 10m. monitoring hooks enabled.

maria: watching metrics now. will call out if anything spikes.

ops-jen: I have dashboards up. alert thresholds set: p95 latency 200ms, error rate 3%.

maria: seeing a small uptick in 502s from redis-cache on canary hosts. error rate ~4.2%, p95 240ms. digging into traces.

andrew: thanks. if errors >3% or p95>200ms we unpin immediately. prefer unpin vs full rollback. what's ETA on root cause?

maria: preliminary — model kv cache misses, backend thundering on initial requests. looking at cache warmup script logs.

andrew: ok go ahead and unpin to v2.3.0 if errors don't fall in 5m. I'll prepare the release notes update and notify customers.

maria: errors holding at 4.1% after 3m.

andrew: manual unpin then. command:
```
/deploy unpin rl-2026-04-01-12 --to v2.3.0 --reason "canary errors > threshold"
```

deploy-bot: Unpin request received from andrew. Executing: revert canary traffic to v2.3.0. Progress: 0% -> 100% (in flight).

ops-jen: monitoring logs and downstream queues. will escalate if anything else pops.

maria: creating incident INC-4521 for traceback and cache warmup failure, assigning to infra.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed. rl-2026-04-01-12 -> v2.3.0 restored. timestamp 1824259958. No further traffic to v2.3.1.

andrew: thanks all. I'll paste quick summary into release notes and link to runbook breadcrumbs: https://confluence.redwood.com/rl-2026-04-01-12/postmortem. follow-up in #postmortems if we need an RCA. :thumbsup:
